---
title: "ZLifts Dashboard"
format: dashboard
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
repo_root <- normalizePath(file.path(".."), mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(repo_root, "scripts", "source-analysis.R"))
source_zlifts(repo_root)

sets <- read_lifting_sets(file.path(repo_root, "data", "processed", "lifting_sets.csv"))
validation <- validate_lifting_data(sets)
exercise_summary <- summarize_exercises(sets)
session_summary <- summarize_sessions(sets)
session_progress <- summarize_session_progress(sets)
exercise_progress <- summarize_exercise_progress(sets)

metric_workouts <- session_progress$total_workouts[[1]]
metric_sets <- session_progress$total_sets[[1]]
metric_reps <- session_progress$total_reps[[1]]
metric_volume <- session_progress$cumulative_volume_lb[[1]]
metric_latest <- session_progress$latest_workout_date[[1]]
metric_latest_volume <- session_progress$latest_workout_total_volume_lb[[1]]

format_lb <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(x),
    "Missing",
    paste(scales::comma(x), "lb")
  )
}

format_change_lb <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Needs repeat",
    x > 0 ~ paste0("+", scales::comma(x), " lb"),
    x < 0 ~ paste0(scales::comma(x), " lb"),
    TRUE ~ "0 lb"
  )
}

exercise_progress_table <- exercise_progress |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Exercise = .data$exercise,
    Type = format_equipment_type(.data$equipment_type),
    Workouts = .data$workout_count,
    `Latest recorded max` = format_lb(.data$latest_recorded_max_weight_lb),
    `All-time recorded max` = format_lb(.data$all_time_max_weight_lb),
    `Change from first` = format_change_lb(.data$change_from_first_recorded_max_weight_lb),
    `Latest volume` = format_lb(.data$latest_exercise_volume_lb),
    `Best volume` = format_lb(.data$all_time_highest_exercise_volume_lb),
    Note = .data$progress_note
  )

session_table <- session_summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Date = format(.data$date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    `Activity ID` = .data$activity_id,
    Sets = .data$total_sets,
    Reps = .data$total_reps,
    `Total volume` = scales::comma(.data$total_volume_lb)
  )

validation_table <- validation |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Status = tools::toTitleCase(.data$status),
    Check = gsub("_", " ", .data$check),
    Message = .data$message,
    Count = .data$n
  )
```

# Overview

## Summary

```{r}
bslib::layout_column_wrap(
  width = "180px",
  bslib::value_box("Workouts", scales::comma(metric_workouts), theme = "primary"),
  bslib::value_box("Recorded sets", scales::comma(metric_sets), theme = "secondary"),
  bslib::value_box("Repetitions", scales::comma(metric_reps), theme = "success"),
  bslib::value_box("Total volume", paste(scales::comma(metric_volume), "lb"), theme = "info"),
  bslib::value_box("Latest workout", format(metric_latest, "%b %d, %Y"), theme = "warning"),
  bslib::value_box("Latest volume", paste(scales::comma(metric_latest_volume), "lb"), theme = "danger")
)
```

)
